verification.title: Student and identity verification
verification.description: View student eligibility and identity status separately, and manage your study history.
verification.noSchools: No schools are available yet. You can suggest a school.
verification.privacy: Your information is used to verify your school identity. School passwords are never stored. New review materials are kept for 30 days after review; verification results and study history are stored separately.
verification.consent: I have read the notice and consent to verification of the information provided.
verification.name: Full name
verification.inboundHelp: Send a message from the school mailbox above to this address, then refresh the application status.
verification.validityHelp: Regular verification remains valid indefinitely. Newcomer status has an expiry date; graduates retain alumni eligibility.
verification.removalHelp: An administrator reviews this request. Eligibility stays unchanged until approval. Deleting student verification preserves independent identity and other entitlements.
verification.requested: Request submitted. Existing eligibility is unchanged.
verification.cameraHelp: Take a clear, live photo of your own document on this device or switch to your phone using the QR code.
verification.scanPhone: Scan with your phone to capture
verification.phoneDone: Photo submitted. Return to the original device, refresh the materials and continue the application.
